name: osu-catch-tracker
description: osu!catch (fruits) live score tracker for Taiwan players — rankings, a live score feed, player profiles and per-map stats, modeled on mania-tracker.com. Standalone Netlify site, sibling to the main osu-collection-hanabi site; see SETUP.md. Plain static frontend, no build step — actual function dependencies live in netlify/functions/package.json (installed by @netlify/plugin-functions-install-core, same as the main site).
